title: Open Long-Tailed Recognition In A Dynamic World
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on computer vision, specifically object, scene, and face recognition in long-tailed and open-set scenarios. The fairness analysis conducted is on gender and ethnicity attributes.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a subject of its analysis.
